died.name: James Guthrie
died.cause: prior to execution by hanging for high treason
died.last_words: I take God to record upon my soul that I would not exchange this scaffold with the palace or mitre of the greatest prelate in Britain. The covenants, the covenants shall yet be Scotland's reviving.

died.name: James Buchanan
died.last_words: Oh, Lord God Almighty, as thou wilt!

died.name: Sylvester H. Roper
died.cause: inventor of the Roper steam velocipede, died of a heart attack or subsequent crash during a public speed trial in 1896. It is unknown whether the crash caused the heart attack, or the heart attack caused the crash.

died.name: Adolf Eichmann
died.cause: mumbling prior to execution by hanging for war crimes
died.last_words: I hope that all of you will follow me.

born.name: Robert Cecil, 1st Earl of Salisbury
born.last_words: Ease and pleasure quake to hear of death; but my life, full of cares and miseries, desireth to be dissolved.

born.name: Francis Edgar Stanley
born.cause: killed while driving a Stanley Steamer automobile. He drove his car into a woodpile while attempting to avoid farm wagons travelling side by side on the road.

born.name: Marilyn Monroe
born.cause: over the phone to Peter Lawford, John F. Kennedy's brother-in-law
born.last_words: Say goodbye to Pat, say goodbye to the president and say goodbye to yourself, because you're a nice guy... I'll see... I'll see.

born.name: Georgy Dobrovolsky
born.cause: prior to fatal reentry of Soyuz 11
born.last_words: I am beginning the descent procedure.
